content.title: Amazon.com: New York Yankees Help Hub: Movies & TV
content.text: General availability:Prime members can stream the New York Yankees on Prime Video at home or on the go across hundreds of compatible devices by streaming from the web or using the Prime Video app on smartphones, tablets, set-top boxes, game consoles, and select smart TVs. For a complete list of compatible devices, visit Supported Devices. To sign up for Prime or for a free 30-day trial go to amazon.com/prime.1. Do I have to pay extra to stream coverage of Yankees games on Prime Video?Prime members in New York state, Connecticut, North and Central New Jersey, and Northeast Pennsylvania will have access to stream 20-21 regular season in-market New York Yankees MLB games within the Yankees Television Territory (previously known as the New York Designated Market Area). Non-Prime members can start a 30-day free trial of Prime. For more information visit Prime Video. 2. Which New York Yankees games can I stream?Prime Video broadcasts 20-21 regular season in-market New York Yankees games to customers in the Yankees Television Territory (formerly known as the New York DMA) via the dedicated Yankees Collection Page. 2026 Yankees on Prime Video Schedule:Wednesday, April 08, 2026: vs. Oakland A's, 7:05 PM ETWednesday, April 15, 2026: vs. Los Angeles Angels, 7:05 PM ETWednesday, April 22, 2026: @ Boston Red Sox, 6:45 PM ETTuesday, April 28, 2026: @ Texas Rangers, 8:05 PM ETWednesday, May 06, 2026: vs. Texas Rangers, 7:05 PM ETWednesday, May 13, 2026: @ Baltimore Orioles, 6:35 PM ETWednesday, May 20, 2026: vs. Toronto Blue Jays, 7:05 PM ETWednesday, May 27, 2026: @ Kansas City Royals, 7:40 PM ETWednesday, June 03, 2026: vs. Cleveland Guardians, 7:05 PM ETTuesday, June 09, 2026: @ Cleveland Guardians, 6:40 PM ETWednesday, June 17, 2026: vs. Chicago White Sox, 7:05 PM ETWednesday, June 24, 2026: @ Detroit Tigers, 6:40 PM ETTuesday, June 30, 2026: vs. Detroit Tigers, 7:05 PM ETWednesday, July 08, 2026: @ Tampa Bay Rays, 6:40 PM ETWednesday, July 29, 2026: @ Chicago White Sox, 7:40 PM ETWednesday, August 05, 2026: vs. St. Louis Cardinals, 7:05 PM ETWednesday, August 19, 2026: @ Baltimore Orioles, 6:35 PM ETThursday, August 20, 2026: @ Baltimore Orioles, 6:35 PM ETWednesday, August 26, 2026: vs. Houston Astros, 7:05 PM ETWednesday, September 09, 2026: vs. Colorado Rockies, 7:05 PM ETWednesday, September 23, 2026: vs. Tampa Bay Rays, 7:05 PM ET Dates/matchups subject to change. **AppleTV may broadcast 1 of these Fridays, confirmed information to be added as we get closer to the broadcast date.3. How can I catch up on matches I have missed?The 20-21 Yankees games will be available on demand up to 15 minutes after the match has ended. Replays for games blacked out due to national TV broadcasts are not available on Prime Video.4. Where can I find the full season schedule?For full information on this year's New York Yankees broadcasts on Prime, visit amazon.com/yankees.5. How will fans find Yankees games on Prime Video?Yankees games on Prime Video are available to Prime Members in the Yankees’ home-team footprint (New York state, Connecticut, North and Central New Jersey, and Northeast Pennsylvania) on the web at amazon.com/yankees, and are displayed in the Prime Video app. Prime members will be able to discover and watch Yankees games via the Prime Video home page, the ‘Your Sports’ row, and on the Sports tab. In addition, customers can search for the Yankees using the search tool. Fire TV users will see the Yankees games appear in their Live tab.6. If I am a Prime Video customer whose subscription is based in the New York area, can I stream the games if I happen to be outside the New York area?No, your device needs to be located within the Yankees’ television territory: New York state, Connecticut, North and Central New Jersey, and Northeast Pennsylvania.7. Will Prime Video’s live games be available to MLB.TV subscribers living outside the Yankees’ television territory?Yes, Prime Video’s live games will be available to MLB.TV subscribers living outside the Yankees’ television territory.8. Will there be DVR functionality?Pause, rewind and fast-forward functions will be available on most devices for the Yankees games.9. If I tune into the game in the third inning, for example, but want to go back and stream the game from the start, can I do that while the live telecast is occurring?Yes, you can rewind the game and stream from the beginning.10. Will Prime Video air encore presentations for each Prime game?Games will be available for replay on Prime Video approximately 20 minutes following their conclusion. Yes, customers can also access encore presentations.11. Are regional blackouts based on my location or my billing address?Blackouts are based on your physical location when streaming the game.12. Can I stream games while traveling?Prime Video members traveling outside of New York state, Connecticut, North and Central New Jersey, and Northeast Pennsylvania will not be able to access the Yankees games on Prime Video. 13. My device says “enable location services for game availability"You will need to enable location services on your device in order to stream the New York Yankees Games. Additionally, you may need to deactivate any VPN or proxy servers.14. Which devices can I stream the New York Yankees on?Yankees games are available to Prime members in the Yankees' home-team footprint on the web at amazon.com/yankees, and are displayed in the Prime Video app. Prime members will be able to discover and stream Yankees games via the Prime Video home page, the ‘Your Sports’ row, and on the Sports tab. In addition, customers can search for the Yankees using the search tool. Fire TV users will see the Yankees games appear in their Live tab.15. Do I need a cable subscription?No. You do not need to have a cable subscription to stream the New York Yankees on Prime Video.16. Can I get live stats?Amazon’s X-Ray technology powered by Amazon Web Services (AWS), allows viewers access to live in-game stats, team and player details, and real-time play-by-play information for fans streaming on Android, iOS mobile, and Fire TV. The games will be streamed in 1080p. DVR functionality (pause, rewind, fast-forward) will be available on most devices.17. What other information is available?Visit our help pages here, or for further help, please contact us via chat or phone.
